No—the ERP was not removed, and inventory was not moved into SupplyOS.

| App | Routes | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/erp` | `/inventory`, `/suppliers/[partId]` | Mock ERP, inventory and supplier records |
| `apps/web` | `/chat`, `/pitch` | SupplyOS case review and buyer interface |
| `apps/api` | FastAPI endpoints | Shared backend and sourcing workflow |

The flow is:

`ERP /inventory` → creates case through `POST /cases` → redirects to `SupplyOS /chat?case=<id>`

Only the old root `/ui` directory was removed because it was moved and simplified into `apps/erp`. SupplyOS cannot create its own case and does not contain the inventory interface.

- SupplyOS: <http://localhost:3001/chat>
